correctness.rationale: Normalizing rank-r sandwich matrix preserves ordinary ranks. The four idempotence block identities and three sufficient commutation equations have been independently recomputed. Four orthogonal joint-projection eigenspaces exhaust all commuting idempotent cores even in characteristic two; orbit-stabilizer gives GLr/product(GLdim), and coupled upper-right and lower-left lifts each have exactly b+c+d free entries per external coordinate. Hence all coefficients follow. General proof covers r=0, all finite fields and m,n>=1. A standalone checker completely enumerates ten small-field cases including GF(4); experiments do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: Commuting idempotents control a canonical graph/relation intrinsic to a sandwich semigroup. Exact bivariate rank distributions across all m,n,r,q are a natural genuinely two-point algebraic statistic and are not determined by older univariate idempotent enumerations. The universal four-sector classification, coupled lift degrees, arbitrary-characteristic formula and fixed-q,r large-rectangle commutation asymptotic form a structural infinite-family theorem rather than a narrow ad hoc computation.
